Backend Engineer

Example Payments builds cross-border payment APIs for online merchants. The team owns the services that move money between payment providers, so reliability and clean API design matter more than anything.

What you will do

Design and build REST APIs in Node.js, integrate external payment providers, and improve monitoring of the services in production.

What we are looking for

Experience with Node.js or .NET, microservices and SQL. Experience with AI agents or automation is a plus.

Please send us a note on why you want to be part of our team
